description_en: Creates an order for the initial installation fee of an Express Connect circuit port by calling CreatePhysicalConnectionSetupOrder
kebab_example: aliyun vpc create-physical-connection-setup-order --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --access-point-id ap-cn-beijing-ft-A --line-operator CT --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreatePhysicalConnectionSetupOrder

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Express Connect circuit. 

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
物理专线所在的地域ID。 

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The carrier that provides the physical connection. Valid values:

CT: China Telecom

CU: China Unicom

CM: China Mobile

CO: Other carriers in the Chinese mainland

Equinix: Equinix

Other: Other carriers outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
提供接入物理线路的运营商。取值：

CT：中国电信

CU：中国联通

CM：中国移动

CO：中国其他

Equinix：Equinix

Other：中国境外其他
parameters.name: line_operator

parameters.help_en:
The port type of the Express Connect circuit. Valid values:

100Base-T: 100M Ethernet port.

1000Base-T (default): 1 GE electrical port.

1000Base-LX: GE single-mode optical port (10 km).

10GBase-T: 10 GE electrical port.

10GBase-LR: 10 GE single-mode optical port (10 km).

40GBase-LR: 40 GE single-mode optical port.

100GBase-LR: 100 GE single-mode optical port.

The default value 1000Base-T is available only at access points that support this port type. Before calling this operation, call ListBusinessAccessPoints to query the SupportPortTypes of the target access point. For optical ports, also verify the OpticalModuleModels.

40GBase-LR and 100GBase-LR must be created based on the actual backend port availability. Contact your account manager for details
parameters.help_zh:
物理专线接入端口类型。取值：

100Base-T：百兆电口。

1000Base-T（默认值）：千兆电口。

1000Base-LX：千兆单模光口（10千米）。

10GBase-T：万兆电口。

10GBase-LR：万兆单模光口（10千米）。

40GBase-LR：四万兆单模光口。

100GBase-LR：十万兆单模光口。

默认值1000Base-T仅在支持该端口类型的接入点可用。调用前请通过ListBusinessAccessPoints查询目标接入点的SupportPortTypes；光口还应核对OpticalModuleModels。

40GBase-LR和100GBase-LR需要根据实际后台端口水位情况进行创建，具体水位情况请联系商务经理
parameters.name: port_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the redundant Express Connect circuit. The circuit must be in the Allocated, Confirmed, or Enabled state
parameters.help_zh: 冗余物理专线的ID，该专线的状态必须为Allocated、Confirmed或Enabled
parameters.name: redundant_physical_connection_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic payment. Valid values:

false (default): Automatic payment is disabled.
true: Automatic payment is enabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动支付。取值：

false（默认值）：不自动支付。
true：自动支付
parameters.name: auto_pay

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a parameter value from your client to ensure uniqueness across different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may vary for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token
